messages:
Olivia Chen: quick handoff — embedding-quality-regression alert triggered 02:14 UTC; impact: similarity search scores down ~3-5% for requests hitting quantized model group. Mitigations applied: routed traffic to emb-fp16-v2, disabled prefix-cache warmup for affected pods. current: traffic routed, error rate back to normal but quality delta remains. link to alert: https://dash.redwood/alerts/embedding-regression-0214
Jia Park: on it. I'll run the focused eval suite (1k holdout prompts) now — ETA ~45m. saving outputs to /tmp/jia/emb-eval-1784629.json
Marcos Rivera: I rolled back the recent quantization microchange on ded-cluster-1 and disabled autoscale burst to reduce eviction churn. opened PR #4217 with a small rounding fix: https://git.redwood/pr/4217
oncall-bot: alert created: embedding-regression-2026-03-17-0214 · severity=P1 · triggered by model-quality-monitor
Sam Patel: FYI saw a burst of 429s when the router switched to fp16 variant — looks like connection pool exhaustion on gateway. Requeued a couple of stuck batcher jobs and bumped gateway pool size by +2. watching.
Olivia Chen: monitoring paths: /dash/models/embeddings/similarity_accept_rate and /dash/infra/kv_cache/evictions. If similarity_accept_rate < 0.92 for 30m escalate to eng-ml@. Also keep an eye on p99 latency for canary.
Jia Park: eval done — mean cosine delta -2.8% vs baseline. sample diffs uploaded. My recommendation: canary fp16 but only 5-10% traffic with smoke tests enabled, then run larger 1k traffic canary if metrics stable.
Marcos Rivera: starting canary deploy to 5% now. command: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood/deploy" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"emb-fp16-v2","traffic":0.05}'
```
logs: tail -n 200 /var/log/deploy/canary-emb-fp16.log | sed -n '1,120p'
Sam Patel: after initial canary we saw a small bump in 503s from batcher-3 — rebalanced batcher-3 -> batcher-4 and warmed connections. latency back within SLO. will keep a 15m watch.
Olivia Chen: next steps for oncall: Jia to run expanded canary (1k requests) if Marcos's 5% smoke is green. Sam to monitor gateway 429/503 and KV eviction. I'll update the incident doc and start a short postmortem draft. handing off to Sam for next 4h. thanks — :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deployment event: emb-fp16-v2 -> 5% traffic · status=starting
Marcos Rivera: canary health checks passing 6/6, p50 latency 42ms, p95 88ms. will open for 10% in 20m if stable. ping me in-thread for any anomalous diffs.
Sam Patel: acknowledged. I'll post any alerts in this thread and escalate to oncall if acceptance metrics cross thresholds.
